principles: Runtime confidence is diagnostic confidence, not a probability of truth or an empirical effect size.
A provisional seed or provisional edge cannot produce an accepted inferred conclusion.
Inferred hypotheses inherit the strongest relevant uncertainty/boundary condition on their path.
Contradictory evidence is attached to the decision it affects rather than averaged away.
When multiple mechanisms explain the same observation, keep alternatives until discriminating evidence exists.
If a strategy recommendation depends on a high-uncertainty mechanism, mark it experimental and produce a test hook.
Facts and product limitations override persuasive convenience.

downgrade_rules.then: runtime_status cannot exceed weak_candidate without independent support
strategy status becomes bounded or experimental
